# Gate or material-decision record — TEMPLATE

**Draft template; no decision or authorization recorded.** Copy the applicable sections into `docs/gates/` or `docs/decisions/`, replace placeholders, and link supporting evidence. The [master prompt](../../prompts/astra-analytics-delivery-master-prompt.md) governs authority and gate behavior; this form records decisions rather than granting them.

## Identity and prerequisites

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Run ID / prompt revision | Unknown — not populated |
| Gate number / name, or decision ID / title | Unknown — not populated |
| Record revision / prepared date / author | Unknown — not populated |
| Decision owner | Unknown — identify Human Manager or Astra within delegated scope |
| Gate status | Not Started |
| Material-decision status, if applicable | Proposed |
| Prerequisite decisions and scope | Unknown — link actual decision records |
| Prior revision / superseded record | Unknown — retain previous decisions when reopened |

Gate status vocabulary: `Not Started`, `In Progress`, `Awaiting Decision`, `Approved`, `Approved with Conditions`, `Rework Required`, `Stopped`. Material-decision status vocabulary: `Proposed`, `Accepted`, `Rejected`, `Superseded`. Recommendations and readiness assessments are separate from the recorded manager decision.

## Conditions and closure

An empty row is not an open or closed condition. Replace it with actual conditions, or explicitly record that none were imposed when supported by the decision source.

| Condition ID | Requirement | Owner | Due date / gate / event | Blocking or nonblocking; affected work | Work expressly permitted while open | Closure criterion and evidence | Closure authority / delegated objective check | Closure outcome, date, and source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | None recorded | Unknown | Unknown | No closure recorded |
